purpose: Capture daily, evidence-backed observations that can feed the self-improvement loop without changing runtime behavior.

evidence_rules: Base observations on inspected repo state, command output, CI evidence, or documented release blockers.
Distinguish active blockers from historical, superseded, or credential-blocked evidence.
Do not record secret values; references to host-managed env files may name paths only.
If the observation changes runtime behavior, it must leave this metadata-only surface and follow protected-surface review.
observation_policy.promotion_trigger: Promote only when the observation identifies a reusable lesson, repeated blocker, missing contract surface, or release-readiness gap that should change a repo contract, runbook, template, or backlog.
